run: pwsh ./scripts/install.ps1 -Destination ./artifacts/muthur; then set MUTHUR_HOME to a scratch directory and run ./artifacts/muthur/muthur.exe up (dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:7420)
notes: Never point a development build at the real %LOCALAPPDATA%\Muthur home: set MUTHUR_HOME to a scratch directory. Warnings are errors. Tests use HubFactory (isolated temp data dir + FakeTimeProvider).
